title: r e u h b l f
cando: read and write words with seven more letters

about.text: In this lesson you learn the sounds r, e, u, h, b, l, f. You hear each sound, you write its letters, and then you read words and a short text with them.
about.speech: In this lesson you learn seven new sounds, and how to write them. You hear each sound, you write its letters, and then you read words and a short text with them.
goals: Say the sound each new letter makes
Join sounds together to read a word
Break a word into sounds to write it
Read the new words out loud

chapters.title: r e u
chapters.text:
This is Lesson 4. Three more letters.
Two of them are vowels.
First. rrr. A growl. rrr.
Say it with me. rrr.
Next. e. Short and open. e.
Say it with me. e. e. e.
Last. u. From the throat. u.
Say it with me. u. u. u.
Now stop and count what you know.
a. e. i. o. u.
Those five are the vowels.
Say them with me. a. e. i. o. u.
Every short word has one of them.
Look. Cat has a. Pin has i.
Dog has o. Cup has u. Red has e.
If you cannot find a vowel, look again.
Now join the new sounds.
rrr. u. nnn. Run.
Say it with me. r-u-n. Run.
Another. b. u. sss. Bus.
And. rrr. e. d. Red.
Three tricky words today. He. We. Me.
They all end the same. He. We. Me.

chapters.title: h b l f
chapters.text:
Four more letters.
First. h. Just a breath. h.
Put your hand near your mouth.
Say h. Feel the air.
There is no voice in h. Only air.
Next. b. A pop from your lips. b.
Say it with me. b. b. b.
Careful. In b the line comes first.
Then the circle. That is b, not d.
Next. lll. Tongue behind your teeth.
Say it with me. lll. Hold it.
Last. fff. Teeth on your lip.
Say it with me. fff. Hold it.
Now join them.
h. a. t. Hat.
Say it with me. h-a-t. Hat.
Another. b. e. d. Bed.
And. lll. e. g. Leg.
And. fff. u. nnn. Fun.
Now count what you know.
You have sixteen letters.
Most short words are open to you.
Three tricky words. Of. Be. His.
Of sounds like ov. It does not follow the rule.

sounds.about: A growl at the back of your mouth. rrr.
A short open sound. e, as in egg.
A short sound from the throat. u, as in up.
A breath out, with no voice. h.
A small pop from your lips. b.
The tongue behind your teeth. lll.
Air between your teeth and lip. fff.

reader.title: The Red Bus
reader.text:
I get up at ten.
I run to the bus.
The bus is red.
I sit. I do not run.
A man got on. He sat.
We go on the red bus.

canDo: I can say the sounds r, e, u, h, b, l.
I can read words like run and red.
I can write a word from its sounds.
I can read a short text out loud.
